title: Bringing back an archived member from Add member throws away everything the desk just typed
what: When the desk adds a member whose mobile number belongs to an archived member, the form offers 'Bring them back'. Pressing it only un-archives the old record and opens their page. The name, batch, joining date, gender, birthday, email, address, emergency contact, notes, pass company and photo the desk typed into the form are dropped without a word, and the member keeps the old details on file.
expected: Either the typed details are saved onto the brought-back member, or the desk is told plainly that only the old details are kept and what to re-enter.
who: front desk and owners re-joining old members
how_often: every time an archived member re-joins through Add member
fix_line: Save the typed details onto the brought-back member, or say on the banner that they will be lost

title: Two desks freezing the same plan at the same time give the member the days twice
what: Freeze / extra days carries no check that the plan's last day is still the one the desk saw. When two logins (owner and front desk, or two desks) add days to the same plan at about the same time, the second save is simply re-run on top of the first, so a 7-day freeze becomes 14 days with no warning. Money sheets are protected from this by the 'more than due' check; this sheet has nothing like it.
expected: The second save is stopped, or asked about, when the plan's last day changed after the sheet was opened.
who: gyms with more than one desk login
how_often: rare, when two people act on the same freeze request
fix_line: Send the last day the sheet showed and refuse the save if it has moved

title: The receipt number written on the UPI payment is a guess and can differ from the receipt given
what: The UPI QR on Collect payment and on the sell sheet puts 'Receipt <number>' into the member's UPI payment note. That number is worked out on this screen as 'highest receipt seen + 1'. If another desk takes a payment first, or this device is using its own offline series, the real receipt gets a different number, and the member's bank record names a receipt that is someone else's. Collect payment also guesses it for today even when the payment is dated back into the previous financial year.
expected: The UPI note names no receipt number until one is issued, or says only the member and plan.
who: members paying by UPI, owners matching bank statements
fix_line: Leave the receipt number out of the UPI note

title: The sell sheet never tells the front desk its 31-day limit on the payment date, unlike Collect payment
what: Both sheets refuse a front-desk payment dated more than 31 days back. Collect payment says so under the date box ('Today, or up to 31 days back'); the sell sheet's 'Received on' box shows no such hint, so the desk only learns the rule after pressing Confirm.
expected: The same hint under 'Received on' on both money sheets.
how_often: when a sale is written in days later
fix_line: Show the same 31-day hint on the sell sheet
